parameters.name: Names
parameters.description: The name of the encryption parameter. Multiple encryption parameters can form a JSON array in the format of \["xxxxxxxxx", "yyyyyyyyy", … "zzzzzzzzz"]. Each JSON array can contain a maximum of 10 encryption parameters. Multiple encryption parameters in the array are separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: WithDecryption
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to decrypt the parameter value. Default value: false. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos get-secret-parameters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --names secretParameter_,_secretParameter1 --with-decryption false --region cn-hangzhou
